name: jev-browser
description: Browser automation where Claude plans one outcome at a time and a fast decision model (Jev, TypeSafe System One) picks every click and keystroke, so Claude rarely has to read page snapshots.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for the TypeSafe System One API (Jev), from https://docs.typesafe.ai. Calls are billed to this key.

headed.title: Show the browser window
headed.description: Run Chromium visibly and outline each element before Jev acts on it. Needed for logging in by hand and for sites that block headless browsers.

browser_profile.title: Browser profile directory
browser_profile.description: Absolute path to a persistent Chromium profile, so logins survive restarts. Leave empty for a fresh profile each session.
